title: trifolium hybridum subsp. elegans
intro: Trifolium hybridum subsp. elegans, commonly known as Red Clover, is a perennial legume plant native to Europe and Western Asia. This plant is valued for its medicinal and nutritional properties, offering several health benefits, including alleviating menopausal symptoms, improving cardiovascular health, and supporting bone health. The therapeutic actions of Red Clover include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and estrogenic effects, which contribute to its potential in treating various conditions such as hot flashes and osteoporosis. The bioactive constituents of Red Clover include isoflavones, such as formononetin and genistein, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and are also found in other legume plants.
